additional_context: ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini, so the inspected StructureDefinition is current build input. Vocab 2021-10-06 minutes support the change-required decision. A 2023 Zulip thread raised implementation concerns and possible preferences for future removal, but no later final Jira reversal was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies the accepted request and no authoritative later decision requires removal or redesign.
